name: OmaPrayers
author: Salem Sayed
description: Prayer times in the Omarchy bar, calculated offline: a to-scale day strip or a ruled timetable, Arabic and English, selectable calculation methods and notifications.

barWidget.description: Next prayer, countdown, Hijri date, offline calculation, selectable methods, and optional notifications

schema.label: Arabic location label
schema.description: Shown instead of the location label when prayer names are Arabic.

schema.label: Latitude
schema.description: Explicit coordinates avoid ambiguous city matching.

schema.label: IANA timezone
schema.description: For example Africa/Cairo or Europe/London. This must match the prayer location.

schema.label: Calculation method
schema.description: Calculation authority. Pick it on the panel; ids are AlAdhan's: 0 Jafari, 1 Karachi, 2 ISNA, 3 MWL, 4 Umm al-Qura, 5 Egypt (default), 7 Tehran, 8 Gulf, 9 Kuwait, 10 Qatar, 11 Singapore, 12 France, 13 Turkey, 14 Russia, 15 Moonsighting, 16 Dubai, 17 Malaysia, 18 Tunisia, 19 Algeria, 20 Indonesia, 21 Morocco, 22 Portugal, 23 Jordan, 99 custom.

schema.label: Shafaq
schema.description: Used by the Moonsighting Committee method.

schema.label: Per-time tuning
schema.description: Nine local-engine minute offsets: Imsak,Fajr,Sunrise,Dhuhr,Asr,Maghrib,Sunset,Isha,Midnight. The panel edits the six prayer and sunrise values.

schema.label: Custom method settings
schema.description: Config-only values for method 99: Fajr angle, Maghrib angle, Isha angle. Empty or null values default to 15°, sunset, 15°.

schema.label: Panel layout
schema.description: Horizon draws the day to scale with window lengths. Compact is the ruled timetable card.

schema.label: Arabic font family
schema.description: Font used for Arabic prayer names. The bar's monospace font has no Arabic glyphs.
